title: [DOC2-10] Chain-witness profile records pruning as a `ComplianceRecord`
description: Review finding DOC2-10: Chain-witness profile records pruning as a `ComplianceRecord` (lens DOC2). Location: profiles/compliance-chain-witness.md:89-91; spec/07-compliance.md:96-133. Fix: §7.4 gives `ComplianceRecord` mandatory per-message fields (`senderDID`, `plaintextPayload`, `senderMessage`, `messageKeys`, `groupContext`, `senderLeaf`) and a third-party check that "MUST treat the record as unverified if any step fails". A prune statement fails that check. Apply the reviewer's fix: a practice type such as `urn:agora:practice:CompliancePruneRecord`, signed by the logger DID and chained by `prevRecordCID`, which verifiers exempt from the sender check. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
